G1801.root: middle voice from a compound of [[w:G1722]] and [[w:G3775]]
G1801.strongs: to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen
senses: (οὖς), depon. mid., to give ear to, hearken to: with accusative, [[r:ACT.2.14|Act 2:14.]]† Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע (AS)

G1805.strongs: to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity)
senses: to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, [[r:EPH.5.16|Eph 5:16]], [[r:COL.4.5|Col 4:5]] (Cremer, 60).† (AS)

G1807.strongs: actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release
senses: ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, [[r:MAT.5.29|Mat 5:29 18:9]]; mid.
to take out for oneself, choose: [[r:ACT.26.17|Act 26:17]] (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.);
ἐξ-αίρω to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: [[r:1CO.5.13|1Co 5:13]] (LXX)† (AS)
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), [[r:LUK.22.31|Luk 22:31]] (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).† (AS)

ἐξ-αίφνης (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. [[r:ACT.22.6|Act 22:6]]; see App., p. 151, and cf. M, Pr., 35), adv. (ἄφνω), suddenly [[r:MRK.13.36|Mrk 13:36]], [[r:LUK.2.13|Luk 2:13 9:39]], [[r:ACT.9.3|Act 9:3 22:6]].† (AS)

G1811.strongs: to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to
senses: ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaphorically, [[r:2PE.1.16|2Pe 1:16 2:2 2:15]] † (AS)

G1813.strongs: to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin)
senses: to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, [[r:REV.7.17|Rev 7:17 21:4]]; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14]]; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, [[r:REV.3.5|Rev 3:5]] (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19]] (cf. [[r:PSA.51.11|Psa 51:11]] [[r:PSA.109.13|Psa 109:13]], [[r:ISA.43.25|Isa 43:25]], [[r:SIR.46.20|Sir 46:20]] (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), [[r:3MA.2.19|3Ma 2:19]]).† (AS)
ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ (ἐξανίστημι), a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, [[r:PHP.3.11|Php 3:11]] (Cremer, 308).† (AS)

G1816.strongs: to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate
senses: trans., to cause to spring up (LXX).

G1817.strongs: objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object

senses: ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω, to deceive: with accusative, [[r:ROM.7.11|Rom 7:11]] [[r:ROM.16.18|Rom 16:18]], [[r:1CO.3.18|1Co 3:18]], [[r:2CO.11.3|2Co 11:3]], [[r:2TH.2.3|2Th 2:3]]; pass., [[r:1TI.2.14|1Ti 2:14.]]† (AS)

G1819.root: from [[w:G1537]] and a derivative of the same as [[w:G0160]]

G1820.strongs: to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond
senses: ἐξ-απορέω, -ῶ so in NT, depon. pass., to be utterly at a loss, be in despair: absol. (as Ps, l.with), [[r:2CO.4.8|2Co 4:8]]; τοῦ ζῆν, [[r:2CO.1.8|2Co 1:8.]]† (AS)

G1821.strongs: to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss
senses: to send forth: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.7.12|Act 7:12 12:11]], [[r:GAL.4.4|Gal 4:4]]; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, [[r:LUK.24.49|Luk 24:49]]; τ. πνεῦμα, [[r:GAL.4.6|Gal 4:6]]; before εἰς, [[r:ACT.22.21|Act 22:21]]; pass., ὁ λόγος, [[r:ACT.13.26|Act 13:26.]]

to send away: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, [[r:ACT.9.30|Act 9:30]]; before ἕως, [[r:ACT.11.22|Act 11:22]]; with inf., [[r:ACT.17.14|Act 17:14]]; κενόν, [[r:LUK.1.53|Luk 1:53 20:10-11]].† (AS)

G1822.strongs: to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher)
senses: to furnish, supply: pass., [[r:2TI.3.17|2Ti 3:17]] (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).† (AS)

G1823.strongs: to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments)
senses: ἐξ-αστράπτω to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, [[r:LUK.9.29|Luk 9:29.]]† (AS)

G1824.root: from [[w:G1537]] and the genitive case singular feminine of [[w:G0846]] ([[w:G5610]] being understood)
G1824.kjv: by and by, immediately, presently, straightway
senses: ἐξ-αυτῆς (a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας) at once, forthwith: [[r:MRK.6.25|Mrk 6:25]], [[r:ACT.10.33|Act 10:33]] [[r:ACT.11.11|Act 11:11]] [[r:ACT.21.32|Act 21:32]] [[r:ACT.23.30|Act 23:30]], [[r:PHP.2.23|Php 2:23]].† (AS)

G1825.strongs: to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction)
senses: ἐξ-εγείρω to raise up: [[r:ROM.9.17|Rom 9:17]] (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, [[r:1CO.6.14|1Co 6:14.]]† (AS)

G1826.strongs: to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore)
senses: ἔξ-ειμι (εἶμι), to go forth: [[r:ACT.13.42|Act 13:42]] [[r:ACT.17.15|Act 17:15]] [[r:ACT.20.7|Act 20:7]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:ACT.27.43|Act 27:43.]]† (AS)

G1828.strongs: to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin)
senses: ἐξ-έλκω to draw out or away: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, [[r:JAS.1.14|Jas 1:14]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

G1829.root: from a comparative of [[w:G1537]] and a presumed ἐράω (to spue)

senses: ἐξ-εραυνάω (Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, to search out, search carefully: before περί, [[r:1PE.1.10|1Pe 1:10.]]† (AS)

G1831.kjv: come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad
senses: depon., to go, or come out of: [[r:MAT.10.11|Mat 10:11]], [[r:MRK.1.35|Mrk 1:35]], [[r:JHN.13.30|Jhn 13:30]], al.; with inf., [[r:MAT.11.8|Mat 11:8]], [[r:MRK.3.21|Mrk 3:21]], [[r:LUK.7.25|Luk 7:25, 26]] [[r:ACT.20.8|Act 20:8]]; id. before ἐπί, [[r:MAT.26.55|Mat 26:55]], al.; εἰς, [[r:MRK.1.38|Mrk 1:38]]; ἵνα, [[r:REV.6.2|Rev 6:2]]; ἐ. before ἐκ (cl. with genitive loc.), [[r:MRK.5.2|Mrk 5:2]], [[r:JHN.4.30|Jhn 4:30]], al.; ἔξω, with genitive, [[r:MAT.21.17|Mat 21:17]], [[r:MRK.14.68|Mrk 14:68]], [[r:ACT.16.13|Act 16:13]], [[r:HEB.13.13|Heb 13:13]]; ἀπό, [[r:MRK.11.12|Mrk 11:12]], [[r:LUK.9.5|Luk 9:5]], [[r:PHP.4.15|Php 4:15]]; ἐκεῖθεν, [[r:MAT.15.21|Mat 15:21]], [[r:MRK.6.1|Mrk 6:1]], [[r:LUK.9.4|Luk 9:4]], al.; of demons expelled, before ἐκ (ἀπό), with genitive of person(s), [[r:MRK.1.25|Mrk 1:25, 26 5:8]], [[r:LUK.4.35|Luk 4:35]], al.; of prisoners released, [[r:MAT.5.26|Mat 5:26]], [[r:ACT.16.40|Act 16:40]]; ptcp., ἐξελθών, with indic., of verb of departure (cf. Dalman, Words, 20f.), [[r:MAT.8.32|Mat 8:32 15:21 24:1]], [[r:MRK.16.8|Mrk 16:8]], [[r:LUK.22.39|Luk 22:39]], [[r:ACT.12.9|Act 12:9, 17]] al. Metaphorical,

of persons: [[r:2CO.6.17|2Co 6:17]], [[r:1JN.2.19|1Jn 2:19]]; of birth or origin, [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]] (LXX), [[r:HEB.7.5|Heb 7:5]] (cf. [[r:GEN.35.11|Gen 35:11]]); of escape from danger, ἐκ τ. χειρὸς αὐτῶν, [[r:JHN.10.39|Jhn 10:39]]; of public appearance, [[r:1JN.4.1|1Jn 4:1]];

of things: [[r:MAT.24.27|Mat 24:27]]; esp. of utterances, reports, proclamations: φωνή, [[r:REV.16.17|Rev 16:17 19:5]]; φήμη, [[r:MAT.9.26|Mat 9:26]], [[r:LUK.4.14|Luk 4:14]]; ἀκοή, [[r:MRK.1.28|Mrk 1:28]]; λόγος, [[r:JHN.21.23|Jhn 21:23]]; δόγμα, [[r:LUK.2.1|Luk 2:1]] (cf. δι-εξέρχομαι). (AS)

G1832.root: third person singular present indicative of a compound of [[w:G1537]] and [[w:G1510]]
G1832.strongs: so also neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public)

G1833.strongs: to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate
senses: ἐξ-ετάζω (ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), to examine closely, inquire carefully (of): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]]; before τίς, [[r:MAT.10.11|Mat 10:11]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:JHN.21.12|Jhn 21:12.]]† SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see DCG, ii, 594b) (AS)

G1834.strongs: to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold
senses: ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι to lead, show the way; metaphorically, to unfold, narrate, declare: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.24.35|Luk 24:35]] [[r:ACT.21.19|Act 21:19]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.10.8|Act 10:8]]; θεόν (understood), [[r:JHN.1.18|Jhn 1:18]]; before ὅσα, [[r:ACT.15.12|Act 15:12]]; καθώς, [[r:ACT.15.14|Act 15:14.]]† (AS)

G1836.root: from [[w:G2192]] (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining)
senses: ἑξῆς adv. (ἔχω), in order, successively, next: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, [[r:LUK.9.37|Luk 9:37]]; ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, [[r:LUK.7.11|Luk 7:11]]; τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), [[r:ACT.21.1|Act 21:1]] [[r:ACT.25.17|Act 25:17]] [[r:ACT.27.18|Act 27:18]].† (AS)

G1837.strongs: to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported)
senses: ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, Th., l.with): pass., [[r:1TH.1.8|1Th 1:8.]]† (AS)

G1839.strongs: to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane
G1839.kjv: amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder
senses: causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.24.22|Luk 24:22]], [[r:ACT.8.9|Act 8:9, 11]].
Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., before ἐκ or with genitive, to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν, to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.;
to be beside oneself, be mad: [[r:MRK.3.21|Mrk 3:21]], [[r:2CO.5.13|2Co 5:13]] (opposite to σωφρονεῖν);

G1840.strongs: to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent
senses: ἐξ-ισχύω to have strength enough, to be quite able: with inf., [[r:EPH.3.18|Eph 3:18.]]† (AS)
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ (ὁδός), a going out, departure: [[r:HEB.11.22|Heb 11:22]]; of death, [[r:LUK.9.31|Luk 9:31]], [[r:2PE.1.15|2Pe 1:15]].† (AS)
έξ-ολεθρεύω (so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), to destroy utterly: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, [[r:ACT.3.23|Act 3:23]] (LXX).† (AS)

G1843.strongs: to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully
senses: act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, to profess or agree to do (Field, Notes, 75): [[r:LUK.22.6|Luk 22:6.]]

Mid., to acknowledge, confess (MM, Exp., xiv): τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[r:MAT.3.6|Mat 3:6]], [[r:MRK.1.5|Mrk 1:5]], [[r:JAS.5.16|Jas 5:16]]; τ. πράξεις, [[r:ACT.19.18|Act 19:18]]; before ὅτι, [[r:PHP.2.11|Php 2:11]]; with dative of person(s), to make acknowledgment to one's honour, to praise, give praise to (as in LXX; Kennedy, Sources, 118): [[r:ROM.14.11|Rom 14:11]](LXX) [[r:ROM.15.9|Rom 15:9]] (LXX); before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.11.25|Mat 11:25]], [[r:LUK.10.21|Luk 10:21]] (Cremer, 771).† (AS)

G1844.strongs: to exact an oath, i.e. conjure
senses: to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.).
to adjure: with accusative of person(s), before κατά, with genitive (as frequently in magic π.; MM, Exp., xiv), [[r:MAT.26.63|Mat 26:63.]]† (AS)

G1845.strongs: one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer)

G1846.strongs: to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing)
senses: ἐξ-ορύσσω to dig out, dig up: στέγην, [[r:MRK.2.4|Mrk 2:4]]; metaphorically, ὀφοαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll with; Herod., viii, 116), [[r:GAL.4.15|Gal 4:15.]]† (AS)

G1847.root: from [[w:G1537]] and a derivative of the neuter of [[w:G3762]]
G1847.strongs: to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise
senses: ἐξ-ουδενέω (Rec. -όω; T, -θανόω), -ῶ, to despise, set at nought: [[r:MRK.9.12|Mrk 9:12]] (cf. ἐξουθενέω).† (AS)

G1848.root: a variation of [[w:G1847]] and meaning the same
G1848.kjv: contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought
senses: ἐξ-ουθενέω, -ῶ (οὐθείς, which see), to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.18.9|Luk 18:9 23:11]], [[r:ROM.14.3|Rom 14:3, 10]], [[r:1CO.16.11|1Co 16:11]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:GAL.4.14|Gal 4:14]], [[r:1TH.5.20|1Th 5:20]]; pass., of persons: [[r:MRK.9.12|Mrk 9:12]] (T, -όω), [[r:1CO.6.4|1Co 6:4]]; of things λίθος, [[r:ACT.4.11|Act 4:11]] (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, [[r:2CO.10.10|2Co 10:10]]; τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, [[r:1CO.1.28|1Co 1:28.]]† SYN.: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (see DCG, i, 453b) (AS)

G1849.strongs: privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence
G1849.kjv: authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength
senses: prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (which see): [[r:1CO.9.12|1Co 9:12]]; ἐ. ἔχειν, [[r:2TH.3.9|2Th 3:9]]; id. before inf., [[r:JHN.10.18|Jhn 10:18]], [[r:1CO.9.4|1Co 9:4]], 5; with genitive obj., [[r:ROM.9.21|Rom 9:21]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:REV.22.14|Rev 22:14]]; περί, [[r:1CO.7.37|1Co 7:37.]]

Later (cf. Milligan, Th., 114; MM, Exp., xiv), of the power of right, authority: [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33]], [[r:MRK.11.28|Mrk 11:28]], [[r:LUK.20.2|Luk 20:2]]; of Messianic authority, [[r:MAT.9.6|Mat 9:6]], [[r:MRK.2.10|Mrk 2:10]], al.; of apostolic authority, [[r:2CO.10.8|2Co 10:8 13:10]]; of the authority of government: [[r:MAT.8.9|Mat 8:9 28:18]], Ju 25, [[r:REV.12.10|Rev 12:10]], al.; esp. of judicial authority, [[r:LUK.20.20|Luk 20:20]], [[r:JHN.19.10|Jhn 19:10, 11]].

a ruler or magistrate: [[r:ROM.13.1|Rom 13:1-3]]; pl., [[r:LUK.12.11|Luk 12:11]], [[r:ROM.13.1|Rom 13:1]], [[r:TIT.3.1|Tit 3:1]]; (with) of supramundane powers (syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): [[r:1CO.15.24|1Co 15:24]], [[r:EPH.1.21|Eph 1:21 3:10]], [[r:COL.2.10|Col 2:10]], [[r:1PE.3.22|1Pe 3:22]], al. (Cremer. 236). SYN.: see: δύναμις. (AS)

G1850.kjv: exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of
senses: Trans., to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), [[r:LUK.22.25|Luk 22:25]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:1CO.7.4|1Co 7:4]]; pass., to be held under authority (see Lft., Notes, 214): before ὑπό, [[r:1CO.6.12|1Co 6:12.]]† (AS)

G1851.root: from a compound of [[w:G1537]] and [[w:G2192]] (meaning to stand out)
senses: Metaphorical, eminence, excellence: οἱ κατ᾽ ἐ., the chief men, [[r:ACT.25.23|Act 25:23.]]† (AS)
ἐξ-υπνίζω to awaken out of sleep (= ἀφυπνίζω): with accusative of person(s), [[r:JHN.11.11|Jhn 11:11.]]† (AS)

G1854.strongs: out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively
senses: adverbially: [[r:MAT.12.46|Mat 12:46]], [[r:MRK.3.31|Mrk 3:31 11:4]], [[r:LUK.8.20|Luk 8:20]], [[r:JHN.18.16|Jhn 18:16]], al.; with art., ὁ ἔ., he who is without; metaphorically, in pl., οἱ ἔ., of those outside the Church, [[r:1CO.5.12|1Co 5:12-13]], [[r:COL.4.5|Col 4:5]] (Lft., in l), [[r:1TH.4.12|1Th 4:12]]; ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, [[r:2CO.4.16|2Co 4:16]]; αἱ ἔ. πόλεις, [[r:ACT.26.11|Act 26:11]];
prop. (in answer to the question, Whence ?), from without: [[r:MRK.7.18|Mrk 7:18]]

G1856.strongs: to expel; by implication, to propel
senses: to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: [[r:ACT.27.39|Act 27:39]] (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).† *ἐκ-σώζω, to preserve from danger, bring safe: [[r:ACT.27.39|Act 27:39]] (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).† ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ

to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: [[r:ACT.27.39|Act 27:39]] (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).† *ἐκ-σώζω, to preserve from danger, bring safe: [[r:ACT.27.39|Act 27:39]] (ἐξῶσαι, WH, mg., R, txt., see: ἐξωθέω).† (AS)
(compar., from ἔξω; opposite to ἐσώτερος) outer: σκότος, [[r:MAT.8.12|Mat 8:12]] [[r:MAT.22.13|Mat 22:13]] [[r:MAT.25.30|Mat 25:30]].† (AS)

a feast, festival: [[r:LUK.2.42|Luk 2:42]], [[r:JHN.5.1|Jhn 5:1]], [[r:JHN.6.4|Jhn 6:4]] [[r:JHN.7.37|Jhn 7:37]], [[r:COL.2.10|Col 2:10]]; ἡ ἑ. τοῦ πάσχα, [[r:LUK.2.41|Luk 2:41]], [[r:JHN.13.1|Jhn 13:1]]; τ. ἀζύμων, [[r:LUK.22.1|Luk 22:1]]; ἡ σκηνοπηγία, [[r:JHN.7.2|Jhn 7:2]] (Deiss., LAE, 116); ἐν τ. ἑ., [[r:MAT.26.5|Mat 26:5]], [[r:MRK.14.2|Mrk 14:2]], [[r:JHN.4.45|Jhn 4:45 7:11 12:20]] (εἶναι ἐν ἑ.), [[r:JHN.2.23|Jhn 2:23]]; εἰς τ. ἑ. (for the feast), [[r:JHN.13.29|Jhn 13:29]]; ἀναβαίνειν, ἔρχεσθαι εἰς τ. ἑ., [[r:JHN.4.45|Jhn 4:45 7:8-10 11:56 12:12]]; τῆς ἐ μεσούσης, [[r:JHN.7.14|Jhn 7:14]]; κατὰ ἑ. (at each feast), [[r:MAT.27.15|Mat 27:15]], [[r:MRK.15.6|Mrk 15:6]], [[r:LUK.23.17|Luk 23:17]], R, mg.; τ. ἑ. ποιεῖν, [[r:ACT.18.21|Act 18:21]]; κατὰ τὸ ἔθος τῆς ἑ., [[r:LUK.2.42|Luk 2:42.]]† (AS)

G1860.strongs: an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good)
senses: a summons (as Attic law-term, Dem., al.).

a promise (Dem., Arist., al.): [[r:ACT.23.21|Act 23:21]]; esp. in NT of the divine promises, [[r:ACT.7.17|Act 7:17]], [[r:ROM.4.14|Rom 4:14, 16]] [[r:ROM.9.4|Rom 9:4]], [[r:GAL.3.17|Gal 3:17-18, 21 4:23]], [[r:HEB.8.6|Heb 8:6 11:9, 17]], [[r:2PE.3.9|2Pe 3:9]]; with inf., [[r:HEB.4.1|Heb 4:1]]; γίνεται, etc., with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.2.39|Act 2:39]], [[r:ROM.4.13|Rom 4:13]], [[r:GAL.3.16|Gal 3:16]]; before πρός, [[r:ACT.13.32|Act 13:32 26:6]]; έπαγγέλεσθαι τὴν ἐ., [[r:1JN.2.25|1Jn 2:25]]; ἔχειν ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:HEB.7.6|Heb 7:6]], [[r:2CO.7.1|2Co 7:1]]; εἷναι νἐ έπαγγελίᾳ, [[r:EPH.6.2|Eph 6:2]]; ἡ γῆ τῆς ἐ., [[r:HEB.11.9|Heb 11:9]]; τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐ., [[r:ROM.9.8|Rom 9:8]], [[r:GAL.4.28|Gal 4:28]]; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς ἐ. τ. ἅγιον, [[r:EPH.1.13|Eph 1:13]]; αἱ διαθῆκαι τῆς ἐ., [[r:EPH.2.12|Eph 2:12]]; ἡ ἐ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.4.20|Rom 4:20]]; pl., [[r:2CO.1.20|2Co 1:20]]; αἱ ἐ. τ. πατέρων, [[r:ROM.15.8|Rom 15:8]]; with genitive obj., τ. ζωῆς (see Dalman, Words, 103), [[r:1TI.4.8|1Ti 4:8]]; τ. παρουσίας αὐτοῦ, [[r:2PE.3.4|2Pe 3:4]]; κατ ̓ ἐπαγγελίαν, [[r:ACT.13.23|Act 13:23]], [[r:GAL.3.29|Gal 3:29]], [[r:2TI.1.1|2Ti 1:1]]; δι ̓ ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:GAL.3.18|Gal 3:18]]; συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐ., [[r:EPH.3.6|Eph 3:6]]; λόγος ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:ROM.9.9|Rom 9:9.]] By meton. (cf. ἐλπίς), of a promised blessing: [[r:LUK.24.49|Luk 24:49]], [[r:ACT.1.14|Act 1:14]], [[r:GAL.3.22|Gal 3:22]], [[r:HEB.6.12|Heb 6:12-17 10:36 11:13, 33 11:39]]; with genitive epexeg., [[r:ACT.2.33|Act 2:33]] [[r:GAL.3.14|Gal 3:14]], [[r:HEB.9.15|Heb 9:15]] (Cremer, 27).† (AS)

G1861.strongs: to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself
senses: to profess. Mid., also frequently in both these senses; (with) to promise: with dab. of person(s), [[r:HEB.6.13|Heb 6:13]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ROM.4.21|Rom 4:21]], [[r:TIT.1.2|Tit 1:2]]; with dative of person(s) and accusative of thing(s), [[r:JAS.1.12|Jas 1:12 2:5]], [[r:2PE.2.19|2Pe 2:19]]; ἐπαγγελίαν, [[r:1JN.2.25|1Jn 2:25]]; with inf., [[r:MRK.14.11|Mrk 14:11]], [[r:ACT.7.5|Act 7:5]]; before λέγων, [[r:HEB.12.26|Heb 12:26]]; ptcp., [[r:HEB.10.23|Heb 10:23 11:11]];
to profess: θεοσέβειαν, [[r:1TI.2.10|1Ti 2:10]]; γνῶσιν, [[r:1TI.6.21|1Ti 6:21.]] Pass., [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19]] (cf. προ-επαγγέλλω; and see Cremer, 26).† (AS)

G1862.strongs: a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good)

G1863.strongs: to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime)
senses: ἐπ-άγω to bring upon: with dative and accusative, [[r:2PE.2.5|2Pe 2:5]]; ἑαυτοῖς ἐ. (for cl. mid., see Mayor, in l), [[r:2PE.2.1|2Pe 2:1]]; ἐ. τὸ αἷμα (cf. Ge 209), [[r:ACT.5.28|Act 5:28.]]† (AS)
to contend for (C.I., 2335, 19): with dative of thing(s), Ju 3.† (AS)

ἐπ-αινέω, -ῶ to praise: with accusative, [[r:ROM.15.11|Rom 15:11]], [[r:1CO.11.22|1Co 11:22]]; before ὅτι, [[r:LUK.16.8|Luk 16:8]], [[r:1CO.11.2|1Co 11:2]]; absol., before ὅτι, [[r:1CO.11.17|1Co 11:17.]]† (AS)

ἐπ-αίρω to lift up, raise: τ. ἀρτέμονα, [[r:ACT.27.40|Act 27:40]]; χεῖρας, [[r:LUK.24.50|Luk 24:50]], [[r:1TI.2.8|1Ti 2:8]]; κεφαλάς, [[r:LUK.21.28|Luk 21:28]]; ὀφθαλμούς, [[r:MAT.17.8|Mat 17:8]], [[r:LUK.6.20|Luk 6:20 16:23 18:13]], [[r:JHN.4.35|Jhn 4:35 6:5 17:1]]; φωνήν, [[r:LUK.11.27|Luk 11:27]], [[r:ACT.2.14|Act 2:14 14:11 22:22]]; τ. πτέρναν (figuratively), [[r:JHN.13.18|Jhn 13:18.]] Pass., [[r:ACT.1.9|Act 1:9]]; metaphorically, to be lifted up with pride: [[r:2CO.10.5|2Co 10:5 11:20]].† (AS)

ἐπ-αισχύνομαι to be ashamed (of): absol., [[r:2TI.1.12|2Ti 1:12]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.8.38|Mrk 8:38]], [[r:LUK.9.26|Luk 9:26]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ROM.1.16|Rom 1:16]], [[r:2TI.1.8|2Ti 1:8 1:16]]; ἐπί, with dative of thing(s), [[r:ROM.6.21|Rom 6:21]]; with inf., [[r:HEB.2.11|Heb 2:11]]; with, accusative of person(s), and inf., [[r:HEB.11.16|Heb 11:16]],† (AS)
to beg (as a mendicant; cf. MM, Exp., xiv): [[r:LUK.16.3|Luk 16:3 18:35]] (Cremer, 74).† (AS)

ἐπ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ to follow after; in NT metaphorically; absol.: [[r:MRK.16.20|Mrk 16:20]] (illustrated by use in verifying accounts; see MM, Exp., xiv; Milligan; NTD, 78); with dative of person(s), of sins, [[r:1TI.5.24|1Ti 5:24]] (cf. Ellic. and CGT, in l); τ. ἴχνεσιν, [[r:1PE.2.21|1Pe 2:21]]; ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ, [[r:1TI.5.10|1Ti 5:10.]]† (AS)
to hearken to, hear with favour (one's prayer): with genitive of person(s), [[r:2CO.6.2|2Co 6:2]] (LXX).† (AS)

G1875.strongs: a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as
senses: ἐπ-άν conj. (ἐπεί, which see, ἄν) later form of ἐπήν, after, when: with subjc. Pres., [[r:LUK.11.34|Luk 11:34]]; with subjc. aor., [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], [[r:LUK.11.22|Luk 11:22]].† (AS)

G1876.root: neuter of a presumed compound of [[w:G1909]] and [[w:G0318]]
senses: ἐπάναγκες (sc. ἐστί), it is compulsory, necessary.

G1877.strongs: to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return
senses: ἐπ-αν-άγω to bring up or back (sc. ναῦς); to put out to sea (DB, iii, 63b): [[r:LUK.5.3|Luk 5:3-4]]; intrans., to return: [[r:MAT.21.18|Mat 21:18.]]† (AS)
ἐπ-ανα-μιμνήσκω to remind again: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ROM.15.15|Rom 15:15.]]† (AS)

G1879.strongs: to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely)
senses: ἐπ-ανα-παύω to refresh, cause to rest (upon); mid., to rest upon: metaphorically, with dative, [[r:ROM.2.17|Rom 2:17]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:LUK.10.6|Luk 10:6]] (Cremer, 827).† (AS)

G1880.strongs: to come up on, i.e. return

G1881.strongs: to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack
senses: ἐπ-αν-ίστημι to raise up against; mid., to rise up against: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.10.21|Mat 10:21]], [[r:MRK.13.12|Mrk 13:12]].† (AS)

G1882.strongs: a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation)
senses: ἐπ-αν-όρθωσις, -εως, ἡ (ἐπανορθόω, to correct, restore; of. [[r:2MA.2.22|2Ma 2:22]]) correction: of life, [[r:2TI.3.16|2Ti 3:16]] (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).† (AS)

G1883.strongs: up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.)

senses: to aid, relieve: with dative of person(s), [[r:1TI.5.10|1Ti 5:10 5:16]] (mid., WH, mg.).† (AS)

G1885.root: from a compound of [[w:G1909]] and [[w:G0757]] (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch")
G1885.strongs: a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture
senses: ἐπαρχεία (Rec. -χία, see Bl., § 3, 5), -ας, ἡ (ἔπαρχος, a prefect), the jurisdiction of a prefect, a province: [[r:ACT.23.3|Act 23:3, 34 25:1]].† *†ἐπάρχεισς, -ον, of a prefect: ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἐξουσία) = ἐπαρχεια, which see, [[r:ACT.25.1|Act 25:1]] (WH, mg.).† (AS)

G1886.strongs: a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling

G1887.strongs: occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. ( being implied) to-morrow
senses: ἐπ-αύριον, adv. on the morrow: in NT, ἡ ἐ. (sc. ἡμέρα), [[r:MAT.27.62|Mat 27:62]], [[r:MRK.11.12|Mrk 11:12]], [[r:JHN.1.29|Jhn 1:29]], [[r:ACT.10.9|Act 10:9]], al (AS)

G1888.root: from [[w:G1909]] and [[w:G0846]] and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of φώρ (a thief)
G1888.strongs: in theft itself, i.e. (by analogy) in actual crime
senses: αὐτόφωρος, -ον (αὐτός, φώρ, a thief) prop. with ref. to theft, then generally, in the very act: as freq., neut. dative after ἐπί, [[r:JHN.8.4|Jhn 8:4]] (Rec., ἐπαυτοφώρῳ).† (AS)

G1890.strongs: to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion)
senses: ἐπ-αφρίζω to foam up: metaphorically, τ. αἰσχύνας, Ju 13.† (AS)

G1891.root: from [[w:G1909]] (in the sense of devoted to) and Ἀφροδίτη (Venus)

G1892.strongs: to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against
senses: ἐπ-εγείρω to rouse up, excite: C. accusative of thing(s), διωγμόν, [[r:ACT.13.50|Act 13:50]]; ψυχάς, [[r:ACT.14.2|Act 14:2.]]† (AS)

G1893.strongs: thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause)
G1893.kjv: because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when

G1894.strongs: since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas
G1894.kjv: after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since
senses: of time, when now, after that: [[r:LUK.7.1|Luk 7:1]] (WH, txt.).
ἐπει-δή-περ conj., forasmuch as ("a stately compound," frequently in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): [[r:LUK.1.1|Luk 1:1.]]† (AS)

G1896.root: and other moods and persons of the same tense; from [[w:G1909]] and [[w:G1492]]
senses: ἐπ-εῖδον 2 aor. without Pres. in use; to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods)
with a view to bless: with inf., [[r:LUK.1.25|Luk 1:25]] (cf. DB, 136b).
ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): [[r:HEB.7.19|Heb 7:19]] (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).† (AS)

ἐπειτα, adv. of sequence thereupon, thereafter, then: [[r:LUK.16.7|Luk 16:7]], [[r:GAL.1.21|Gal 1:21]], [[r:JAS.4.14|Jas 4:14]]; before μετὰ τοῦτο, [[r:JHN.11.7|Jhn 11:7]]; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, [[r:GAL.1.18|Gal 1:18]]; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, [[r:GAL.2.1|Gal 2:1]]; πρῶτον... ἔ., [[r:1CO.15.46|1Co 15:46]], [[r:1TH.4.17|1Th 4:17]], [[r:HEB.7.2|Heb 7:2]]; πρότεφον... ἔ, [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27]]; ἀπαρχὴ... ἔ., [[r:1CO.15.23|1Co 15:23]]; εἶτα... ἔ., [[r:1CO.15.5|1Co 15:5-6]] (WH, txt.);... ἔ., [[r:1CO.15.5|1Co 15:5-7]] (WH, mg.); τρίτον... ἔ. (his), [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28.]]† (AS)

G1827.strongs: to convict fully, i.e. (by implication) to punish
senses: ἐξ-ελίγχω to convict: Ju 15, Rec. (for ἐλέγχω, WH, which see).† (AS)
